name: haml-all
description: Including syntax highlighting, linting, formatting, and additional features.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Linting, formatting, Rails routes and HTML-to-HAML conversion stay disabled until you trust the workspace, because they run the project's Ruby tooling (haml-lint, RuboCop, Rails), which executes code from project files (e.g. a `require:` directive in .haml-lint.yml, the Gemfile, bin/rails). Syntax highlighting, snippets and completions work either way.

hamlAll.linterExecutablePath.description: Path to the haml-lint executable, used *only* to check that haml-lint is available. Linting and formatting themselves run through `hamlAll.rubyCommand`. Machine-scoped for security: it cannot be set by a workspace's .vscode/settings.json, only in your user settings.

hamlAll.rubyCommand.description: Ruby interpreter used to run the lint server. Set it to an absolute path when a version manager's shims (rbenv, asdf, mise) are not on the PATH of a GUI-launched VS Code. May include arguments. Machine-scoped for security: it cannot be set by a workspace's .vscode/settings.json, only in your user settings.

hamlAll.useBundler.description: Use `bundle exec` to run haml-lint. (If this is true, the 'linterExecutablePath' setting is ignored.)

hamlAll.railsCommand.description: Command used to run Rails (project detection and `rails routes`). May include arguments, e.g. `bundle exec rails`. Machine-scoped for security: it cannot be set by a workspace's .vscode/settings.json, only in your user settings.

railsRoutes.railsCommand.description: Command used to run Rails (e.g. for project detection and routes). Machine-scoped for security: it cannot be set by a workspace's .vscode/settings.json, only in your user settings.
railsRoutes.railsCommand.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: use `hamlAll.railsCommand` instead. This setting is still read when `hamlAll.railsCommand` is not set.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
